items.title: fix(xai): keep device-code polling deadline on a monotonic clock (#17…
items.summary: fix(xai): keep device-code polling deadline on a monotonic clock (#174227) Use performance.now() for the device-code token polling deadline domain so that wall-clock jumps cannot distort the poll cadence or terminate the loop early. Previously Date.now() seeded and consumed the deadline while the poll delay was applied via monotonic setTimeout; a forward clock jump made the deadline read as expired, aborting an in-flight authorization. Ref: BUG-168-xai-device-code-oauth-deadline-wall-clock (local finding)

items.title: refactor(gateway): bind session PR reads to native Git owners (#177800)
items.summary: refactor(gateway): bind session PR reads to native Git owners (#177800) Remove private Git-root and Git-context selectors from session pull-request reads. Use the existing prepared source and native Git worker, retaining cache lifetime, current authority, retention pins, and publication. Move fixtures to the native boundary and preserve held-read replacement, metadata, physical reopen, and retention assertions. All59 focused behavior cases and14 suppression checks passed, with targeted types, ordinary lint/format, zero cycles, independent review, and exact-head hosted CI. No live GitHub or full local build/E2E claim.
